title: Codewars 5kyu: Pete, the Baker
description: Pete likes to bake some cakes. He has some recipes and ingredients. Write a function `cakes()`, which takes the recipe (dict) and the available ingredients (dict) and returns the maximum number of cakes Pete can bake (integer). Missing ingredients count as 0.
starter_code:
def cakes(recipe: dict, available: dict) -> int:
    pass
solution:
def cakes(recipe: dict, available: dict) -> int:
    return min(available.get(ing, 0) // amt for ing, amt in recipe.items())
explanation: Bottleneck capacity is bounded by min floor division of available supplies by recipe requirements.
